topic: A fictional neighborhood library has six volunteers and can afford two extra opening hours per weekend. Should it extend Saturday hours, Sunday hours, or run a monthly evening event? Discuss access, staffing, and a small experiment. Use no more than 100 words per turn.

participants.name: Access
participants.instructions: Focus on accessibility and community needs. Respond to the other participant's specific points.

participants.name: Staffing
participants.instructions: Focus on volunteer capacity and a measurable trial. Challenge impractical suggestions and explain why.
